Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

Your outline frays into smoke; the lock remains untouched.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, through a visible small opening into a free adjacent square
Duration
One immediate passage; you reform at the destination.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Utility

Move only to a visible free square. Carried equipment travels with you. No lingering gaseous immunity, flight, damage or movement through a sealed barrier. Does not provoke.
